f3_program: collection("water_case.bottles", "bottle", "water_case", source("A case of water contains 24 bottles"))
observe(at("water_case.bottles.count", "current"), 24, "count", source("A case of water contains 24 bottles"))
collection("camp.groups", "group", "camp", source("A children's camp comprising of 4 groups"))

sum_relation(at("camp.groups.first_three.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.first.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.second.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.third.children.count", "current"), source("the number of the first three groups combined"))

fraction_of(at("camp.groups.fourth.children.count", "current"), at("camp.groups.first_three.children.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("the fourth group has half of the number of the first three groups combined"))
observe(at("camp.child.water_bottles.consumed.count", "per_day"), 3, "count", source("each child consumes 3 bottles a day"))
multiple(at("jenny.board_games.with_jill.count", "current"), at("jenny.board_games.with_mark.count", "current"), 2, source("she's played her twice as many times as she's played Mark"))
percent_of(at("jill.board_game_wins.against_jenny.count", "current"), at("jenny.board_games.with_jill.count", "current"), 75, source("Jill has won 75% of them"))
assumptions: The games against Mark and Jill are treated as having one winner and no draws.

f3_program: collection("haleigh.old_candles", "candle", "haleigh", source("five 20 oz candles, 5 five ounce candles, and twenty-five one ounce candles"))
percent_of(at("haleigh.old_candles.each.wax", "remaining"), at("haleigh.old_candles.each.wax", "original"), 10, source("Each candle has 10% of it's original wax left"))
assumptions: The candle sizes denote their original wax amounts, and combining the remaining wax entails no loss.

f3_program: remove("corn_seed_expense", "farmer", at("farmer.money.dollars", "current"), 50, source("spent $50 on corn seeds"))
remove("fertilizer_and_pesticide_expense", "farmer", at("farmer.money.dollars", "current"), 35, source("$35 on fertilizers and pesticides"))
produce("corn_harvest", "farmer", at("farmer.corn_bags.count", "current"), 10, source("gather 10 bags of corn"))
assumptions: The 10% profit is interpreted relative to the total stated cultivation cost.

f3_program: observe(at("men.added_sugar.recommended_maximum.calories", "per_day"), 150, "calorie", source("men should consume no more than 150 calories of added sugar per day"))
consume("soft_drink_intake", "mark", at("mark.soft_drinks.count", "current"), 1, source("Mark took a soft drink in the afternoon"))
observe(at("mark.soft_drink.total.calories", "afternoon"), 2500, "calorie", source("a soft drink in the afternoon that contained 2500 calories"))
percent_of(at("mark.soft_drink.added_sugar.calories", "afternoon"), at("mark.soft_drink.total.calories", "afternoon"), 5, source("5% of which was from added sugar"))
add("candy_bar_purchase", "mark", at("mark.candy_bars.count", "current"), "mark.candy_bars.purchased.count", source("he bought some bars of candy"))
observe(at("mark.candy_bars.each.added_sugar.calories", "current"), 25, "calorie", source("25 calories of added sugar each"))
percent_more(at("mark.added_sugar.calories", "eventual"), at("men.added_sugar.recommended_maximum.calories", "per_day"), 100, source("exceeded the recommended intake of added sugar by 100%"))
assumptions: The candy bars bought are the bars later described as taken, and their added sugar is counted in the same day's intake.
